Official Konami original model viewed. Bare human fingers in ALL32figures; old sudden-glove right page rejected/preserved. Active11 real directional rifle aim, physical10 crouched rifle handling/reload approximation. No younger age, no modern sniper replacement, no exact captured full original animation cycle claim. Existing renderer normalizes original rail-tagged super into deploy instead of charge. Physically reviewed deploy alias therefore explicitly uses the SAME rifle-aim11 with genuine rifle muzzle, not fist9.
